body.purpose: 控制與繁體中文基本內容。

shadows.purpose: 設定頁固定於視窗下方的非阻斷操作回饋。

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: 儲存規則或新增網站的主要提交動作。
components.css: .ds-button-primary { min-height: 36px; padding: 7px 18px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 24px; background: var(--primary); color: var(--on-primary); font: 500 13px/20px "Segoe UI", "Microsoft JhengHei UI", "Noto Sans TC", "Noto Sans CJK TC", system-ui, sans-serif; white-space: nowrap; cursor: pointer; } .ds-button-primary:hover { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--primary) 90%, var(--ink)); } .ds-button-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--primary); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-button-primary:disabled { background: var(--surface-alt); color: var(--muted); cursor: default; }

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: 暫停等次要操作使用表面底與細邊線。
components.css: .ds-button-outline { min-height: 36px; padding: 7px 18px; border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 24px; background: var(--surface); color: var(--primary); font: 500 13px/20px "Segoe UI", "Microsoft JhengHei UI", "Noto Sans TC", "Noto Sans CJK TC", system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-button-outline:hover { background: var(--selected); } .ds-button-outline:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--primary); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: 白名單、分頁搜尋與數字時間欄位。
components.html: <label class="ds-field-label">網站<input class="ds-input" type="text" placeholder="輸入網站"></label>
components.css: .ds-field-label { display: grid; gap: 6px; color: var(--ink); font: 400 13px/20px "Segoe UI", "Microsoft JhengHei UI", "Noto Sans TC", "Noto Sans CJK TC", system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-input { width: 100%; min-height: 36px; padding: 7px 12px; border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 6px; background: var(--surface); color: var(--ink); font: 400 13px/20px "Segoe UI", "Microsoft JhengHei UI", "Noto Sans TC", "Noto Sans CJK TC", system-ui, sans-serif; caret-color: var(--primary); } .ds-input:hover { border-color: var(--control-line); } .ds-input:focus { border-color: var(--primary); outline: 2px solid var(--primary); outline-offset: -1px; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: var(--muted); opacity: 1; }

components.name: Settings Navigation Link
components.description: 目的地導覽；當前位置使用選取角色。
components.css: .ds-nav-link { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 20px; min-height: 44px; padding: 10px 24px; border-radius: 0 24px 24px 0; color: var(--muted); text-decoration: none; font: 400 14px/21px "Segoe UI", "Microsoft JhengHei UI", "Noto Sans TC", "Noto Sans CJK TC", system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-nav-link:hover { background: var(--hover); } .ds-nav-link[aria-current] { background: var(--selected); color: var(--on-selected); font-weight: 500; } .ds-nav-link:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--primary); outline-offset: -2px; }

components.name: Settings Panel
components.description: 以表面、邊線和圓角收納相關設定列。
components.html:
自動卸載背景分頁依規則執行
閒置多久後卸載30 分鐘
components.css: .ds-panel { overflow: hidden; border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 12px; background: var(--surface); color: var(--ink); } .ds-row { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 16px; min-height: 72px; padding: 16px 20px; font: 400 14px/21px "Segoe UI", "Microsoft JhengHei UI", "Noto Sans TC", "Noto Sans CJK TC", system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-row + .ds-row { border-top: 1px solid var(--line); } .ds-row strong { font-weight: 500; }

components.name: Running Status
components.description: 以文字和圓點區分載入中、執行中、暫停、無法使用與重新連線。
components.css: .ds-status { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 7px; color: var(--muted); font: 400 13px/20px "Segoe UI", "Microsoft JhengHei UI", "Noto Sans TC", "Noto Sans CJK TC", system-ui, sans-serif; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-status-dot { width: 6px; height: 6px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--success); } .ds-status[data-paused="true"] .ds-status-dot { background: var(--muted); } .ds-status[data-state="loading"] .ds-status-dot, .ds-status[data-state="paused"] .ds-status-dot, .ds-status[data-state="reconnecting"] .ds-status-dot { background: var(--muted); } .ds-status[data-state="unavailable"] .ds-status-dot { background: var(--error); }

components.name: Settings Row
components.description: 設定說明與右側控制保持同列，窄版可重排。
components.html: 自動卸載切離分頁後開始計時
components.css: .ds-setting-row { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 16px; min-height: 72px; padding: 16px 20px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line); color: var(--ink); font: 400 14px/22px "Segoe UI", "Microsoft JhengHei UI", "Noto Sans TC", "Noto Sans CJK TC", system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-setting-row strong, .ds-setting-row small { display: block; } .ds-setting-row strong { font-weight: 400; } .ds-setting-row small { margin-top: 2px; color: var(--muted); font-size: 13px; line-height: 20px; } .ds-switch { display: flex; align-items: center; width: 34px; height: 20px; padding: 3px; border: 0; border-radius: 20px; background: var(--primary); } .ds-switch span { width: 14px; height: 14px; margin-left: auto; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--on-primary); } .ds-switch:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--primary); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Website Scope and Inherited Protection
components.description: The scope selector remains available for deliberate changes; inherited protection is static and shows a lock, the actual source rule, and its management action.
components.html:
This hostname only; subdomains are excluded.

Protected by parent…ample.com and subdomains rule

full.parent.example.com
components.css: .ds-scope { display: grid; gap: 6px; color: var(--ink); font: 400 13px/20px "Segoe UI", "Microsoft JhengHei UI", "Noto Sans TC", "Noto Sans CJK TC", system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-scope select { width: 100%; min-height: 32px; padding: 5px 8px; border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 6px; background: var(--surface); color: var(--ink); font: inherit; } .ds-scope p { margin: 0 0 0 12px; color: var(--muted); font-size: 12px; line-height: 18px; overflow-wrap: anywhere; } .ds-inherited { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 18px minmax(0, 1fr); gap: 4px 8px; color: var(--muted); font-size: 12px; line-height: 18px; } .ds-inherited > svg { width: 18px; height: 18px; } .ds-inherited button { grid-column: 2; justify-self: start; padding: 3px 0; border: 0; background: transparent; color: var(--primary); font: inherit; font-weight: 500; cursor: pointer; } .ds-hostname { overflow-wrap: anywhere; } .ds-hostname summary { cursor: pointer; border-radius: 2px; } .ds-hostname summary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--primary); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-hostname-full { user-select: text; } .ds-scope select:focus { border-color: var(--primary); outline: 2px solid var(--primary); outline-offset: -1px; } .ds-inherited button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--primary); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Activity History Toolbar and Pagination
components.description: Show the retained-record count, clear action, visible range and 50-item page controls.
components.html:
Up to 200 records · 125 total
51–100 of 125

components.css: .ds-history { color: var(--muted); font: 400 12px/20px "Segoe UI", "Microsoft JhengHei UI", "Noto Sans TC", "Noto Sans CJK TC", system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-history header, .ds-history nav, .ds-history nav div { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 8px 16px; } .ds-history header { padding: 14px 20px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line); } .ds-history nav { padding: 12px 20px; border-top: 1px solid var(--line); } .ds-history nav div { justify-content: flex-end; gap: 4px; margin-left: auto; } .ds-history button { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; padding: 7px 12px; border: 0; border-radius: 24px; background: transparent; color: var(--primary); font: 500 13px/20px "Segoe UI", "Microsoft JhengHei UI", "Noto Sans TC", "Noto Sans CJK TC", system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-history button:hover:not(:disabled) { background: var(--selected); } .ds-history button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--primary); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-history button:disabled { color: var(--muted); cursor: default; } .ds-history svg { width: 16px; height: 16px; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 1.8; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round; }

components.name: Undo Toast
components.description: Shared popup and settings notice: transient success closes when connection recovery takes priority; errors and pending Undo remain, and timers pause during disconnection as well as hover, focus, or busy work.
components.html:
Website rule removed

Connection lost · showing data from 10:42 AM
components.css: .ds-toast-region { padding: 0 12px 12px; } .ds-toast { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; min-height: 48px; padding: 8px 10px 8px 16px; border-radius: 8px; background: var(--inverse); color: var(--on-inverse); box-shadow: 0 4px 14px #0003; font: 400 13px/20px "Segoe UI", "Microsoft JhengHei UI", "Noto Sans TC", "Noto Sans CJK TC", system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-toast span { flex: 1; } .ds-toast button { padding: 7px 12px; border: 0; border-radius: 24px; background: transparent; color: inherit; font: inherit; font-weight: 500; cursor: pointer; } .ds-toast button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid currentColor; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-connection-error { color: var(--error); } .ds-connection-error button { color: var(--primary); } /* On connection failure, dismiss old non-Undo success and return focus; keep errors and pending Undo. Pause notice timers until reconnection. */

components.css: .ds-popup { display: flex; flex-direction: column; width: 360px; min-width: 320px; max-height: 600px; overflow: hidden; background: var(--surface); color: var(--ink); font: 400 13px/20px "Segoe UI", "Microsoft JhengHei UI", "Noto Sans TC", "Noto Sans CJK TC", system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-popup-header, .ds-popup-recovery, .ds-popup-notice, .ds-popup-footer { flex: 0 0 auto; } .ds-popup-recovery { padding: 0 20px 12px; color: var(--muted); } .ds-popup-content { min-height: 0; overflow-y: auto; overscroll-behavior-y: contain; padding: 0 20px 8px; } .ds-popup-notice { padding: 0 12px 12px; } .ds-popup-footer { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; gap: 8px; padding: 8px 12px 8px 20px; border-top: 1px solid var(--line); color: var(--muted); font-size: 11px; line-height: 16px; } .ds-popup-recovery button { color: var(--primary); } /* Measured heights: 475px normal, 503px inherited protection; preserve independent area layout. */

narrative.northStar: 熟悉的設定列，清楚的分頁狀態
narrative.overview:
Scythe Discards 延續使用者指定的 Chrome 設定頁語言，讓人先確認自動卸載狀態，再調整規則、管理網站例外，最後查看分頁狀態與近期紀錄。設定頁用四個真正可切換的目的地承載各項工作；工具列 popup 集中處理暫停、目前分頁保護和網站白名單。Popup 頁首、連線回復區、通知與頁尾各自保留版面，主要內容獨立捲動。

介面提供繁體中文、簡體中文與英語，依 Chrome 語言選擇。系統 UI 字型、中性表面與克制的藍色互動色構成整體。表面、間距、分隔線和清楚的狀態文字負責建立層次；同一組語意角色在淺色和深色外觀中延續。外觀預設跟隨系統或 Chrome 回報的偏好，也可手動指定。品牌名稱統一為 Scythe Discards；透明角色頭像只出現在品牌與擴充圖示，不改變設定頁的 Chrome 方向。Popup 繼承保護顯示鎖定狀態、來源規則與管理入口，網域長值可透過鍵盤展開；連線復原和 Undo 回饋保留真實操作狀態。
keyCharacteristics: 熟悉且緊湊的四目的地設定導覽
三種語言和淺深色共用語意角色
鎖定來源、可展開的完整網域、過期狀態與可復原通知均有明確操作回饋

rules.name: The Shared Roles Rule
rules.body: 淺深色維持相同的狀態語意；由系統偏好或明確主題設定切換實際色值。

dos: Do 使用繁體中文、簡體中文或英語及實際分頁狀態。
Do 保留系統／Chrome 外觀偏好與手動淺色、深色覆寫。
Do 讓狀態同時有文字或圖示線索，並為鍵盤焦點保留清楚外框。
Do 顯示實際網站保護範圍；繼承保護使用鎖定圖示、來源規則和管理動作，範圍選單仍可刻意更改目標。
Do 讓長 hostname 與來源以可鍵盤操作的 disclosure 展開完整、可選取的值，並在同一網站資料刷新時保留展開狀態。
Do 讓活動紀錄顯示 50 筆分頁、200 筆保留上限與清除結果。
Do 對需要明確提交的規則提供儲存、取消和未儲存提示。
Do 讓 popup 頁首、連線回復、通知與頁尾各佔自己的版面，內容區獨立捲動。
Do 對過期資料顯示更新時間並停用遠端操作；載入時不猜測 hostname。
Do 在連線失敗時移除舊的非 Undo 成功通知並返回適當焦點；保留錯誤和待處理 Undo，並暫停通知計時。
donts: Don't 用未經實測的記憶體節省量或效率百分比作為介面主張。
Don't 以裝飾性陰影或多層卡片取代目前的間距、表面與分隔線。
Don't 把 Chrome 設定頁方向誤寫成像素級 Chrome 品牌複製。
Don't 將個人角色肖像擴張成整頁裝飾。
